WITH customer_stats AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerKey,
    SUM(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ProductKey) AS distinct_products,
    MAX(DateKey) AS last_purchase
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerKey,
    total_spend,
    distinct_products,
    CASE
      WHEN dateDiff('month', last_purchase, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 6 THEN 'Active'
      WHEN dateDiff('month', last_purchase, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 12 THEN 'At Risk'
      ELSE 'Churned'
    END AS segment
  FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT
  segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  AVG(total_spend) AS avg_spend,
  AVG(distinct_products) AS avg_product_variety
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment
